methods.name: Inferno Automobili Settimo Cerchio (Around the World Update - required the Jaguar XE SV Project 8, so the Legend Pass)

Delisted from the garage for players who don't own it (Racing Through Fire & Hall of Flames Update) - never offered again after its Special Event. Owners can star it up with existing blueprints, Class S Wild Cards or Class S Ultimate Star-Up Cards, and max it out with existing Epic Import Parts or Epic Wild Cards
